title: a death nobody stated is not searched for in a year the lifespan assumed, and one still to come is not searched for
line: a man born in 1904 with no death in the file has a death-record search that names no year (the lifespan the plan assumes of him gates only the era rows, and no year of it is a claim), and a man born in 1993 with none has no death-record row to search at all, his assumed lifespan ending in a year not yet reached

steps.say: Francis Thomas Ahearn, born 30 Nov 1904, the file gives no death: his baseline reviewed on what it states, and deceased on the owner's word so the plan can write his searches

living.note: harness: so the steps are auto

expect.why: the searches open only on a reviewed baseline
the file states no death, so no year of one is asked: the 1994 a lifespan of ninety years gives was a claim nobody made

steps.say: the home person, born 8 Feb 1993, no death: his baseline reviewed, so the plan writes his searches

expect.why: the searches open only on a reviewed baseline
a lifespan of ninety years from 1993 ends in 2083: a death in a year not yet reached has no record to search for
